title: Indian-Style Chicken Skewers with Crispy Japanese Seasoning
description: A fusion twist on traditional chicken skewers, marinated in Indian spices and seasoned with crispy Japanese flavors. Perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, curry powder, lime juice, ginger, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
2. Add the chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
3. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
4. Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush the skewers with vegetable oil and season with salt and black pepper.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
7. While the skewers are cooking, mix the tempura bits with a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
8. Once the skewers are done, brush them with a little more vegetable oil and sprinkle with the crispy Japanese seasoning.
9. Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
